semantics.exact_statement: Determine the valid input/output subspaces and whether any invertible input and output basis adapters can identify the pinned standalone five-m shear-down map with physical STF T9. For ell_min=0, Lmax=2, source ell0 m0=1, compute rank of its map from arbitrary real shear coordinates and compare to S->STF(S). Distinguish the actual ver3 caller graph, which uses a different builder.

frame_signature_units_conventions.spatial_metric: Euclidean delta_ij in local orthonormal rest frame

assumptions: collisionless massless occupation; initially isotropic case only for ell=2 oracle
pure-shear instantaneous local generator, no A/theta/omega/collision term in target coefficient
S and tensors real; full STF tensor domain
energy integrals and boundary operations justified by stated regularity
positivity_nonzero_conditions: finite nonzero brightness monopole for normalized ratios
branches: no complex branch; real STF primary coordinates
exclusions: general physical eligibility for standalone five-m truncation
transferring standalone findings to ver3 mixing solely by matching variable name
singular_loci: zero reference norm: use absolute equality, no relative division
order_of_limits: prove angular and energy identities before finite h or finite grid limits
no replacement of fixed-h quadrature convergence by h->0
boundary_or_initial_conditions: E^4 f(E,e) -> 0 as E->0 and infinity; E^3 f integrable
ell=0 and ell=1 have no ell-2 source

target.canonical_form: Exact source-derived 5x5 isotropic-input map, kernel and image; invertible-adapter existence or obstruction. Any positive repaired mixed claim needs full real/complex basis and valid-subspace proof before contracting physical T9.
target.equivalence_relation: Exact map equivalence on explicitly stated valid subspaces; rank obstruction suffices for nonexistence on full rank-two STF shear domain
invariants: sigma=Sigma/a and ds=a d eta applied once
exact_test_obligations: derive exact Wigner values from formula, including ell0/1 padded-slot restrictions
derive real shear5 Cartesian and complex-spherical transformations with phases/norms
prove rank obstruction or supply invertible intertwiners
analyze closure of restricted m=-2..2 under arbitrary shear; general ell must not be assumed
trace standalone LHS/RHS documentation and actual current ver3 RHS supplier independently
no mixed repair eligibility until obligations cover every changed coefficient and current consumer
target.absolute_tolerance: exact identities; finite numerical adapter residual <=1e-10
target.relative_tolerance: 1e-10 only for nonzero finite test reference
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not assume the target identity in an intermediate rewrite.
Do not import sibling solver results before adjudication.
Do not label finite ell probes a general ell proof.
Do not use this author draft or another axis result as derivation evidence.
Do not accept stored result strings or preflight as engine execution.
